MOD = 1000000007

class V:
    def __init__(self):
        self.arr = [0] * 30

class M:
    def __init__(self):
        self.mat = [[0] * 30 for _ in range(30)]

def getVal(num):
    if num < baseVal:
        return num
    return (num + getVal(num // baseVal)) % baseVal

def multiply_M(a, b):
    res = M()
    for i in range(baseVal):
        for j in range(baseVal):
            res.mat[i][j] = 0
            for l in range(baseVal):
                res.mat[i][j] += (a.mat[i][l] * b.mat[l][j]) % MOD
            res.mat[i][j] %= MOD
    return res

def multiply_V_m(v, m):
    res = V()
    for i in range(baseVal):
        res.arr[i] = 0
        for j in range(baseVal):
            res.arr[i] += (v.arr[j] * m.mat[i][j]) % MOD
        res.arr[i] %= MOD
    return res

def precompute_matrices():
    global E, EI, matrices, inv_matrices, totalCount, baseVal
    for i in range(baseVal):
        E[0][i] = matrices[i]
        EI[0][i] = inv_matrices[i]
    LOG = 0
    t = totalCount
    while t > 0:
        LOG += 1
        t //= baseVal
    for j in range(1, LOG + 1):
        E[j][0] = E[j - 1][0]
        EI[j][0] = EI[j - 1][0]
        for l in range(1, baseVal):
            E[j][0] = multiply_M(E[j - 1][l], E[j][0])
            EI[j][0] = multiply_M(EI[j][0], EI[j - 1][l])
        for i in range(1, baseVal):
            E[j][i] = multiply_M(E[j - 1][i - 1], multiply_M(E[j][i - 1], EI[j - 1][i - 1]))
            EI[j][i] = multiply_M(E[j - 1][i - 1], multiply_M(EI[j][i - 1], EI[j - 1][i - 1]))

def solve_vector(n, v, at):
    if n == 0:
        return v
    w = getVal(n // baseVal)
    v = solve_vector(n // baseVal, v, at + 1)
    for i in range(n % baseVal):
        v = multiply_V_m(E[at][(w + i) % baseVal], v)
    return v

def main():
    global totalCount, baseVal, E, EI, matrices, inv_matrices, current_vector
    totalCount, baseVal = map(int, input().split())
    matrices = [M() for _ in range(baseVal)]
    inv_matrices = [M() for _ in range(baseVal)]
    E = [[M() for _ in range(baseVal)] for _ in range(200)]
    EI = [[M() for _ in range(baseVal)] for _ in range(200)]
    current_vector = V()
    for i in range(baseVal):
        current_vector.arr[i] = 1
        for j in range(baseVal):
            for l in range(baseVal):
                if j == l:
                    matrices[i].mat[j][l] = 1
                    inv_matrices[i].mat[j][l] = 1
                elif j == i:
                    matrices[i].mat[j][l] = 1
                    inv_matrices[i].mat[j][l] = -1
                else:
                    matrices[i].mat[j][l] = 0
                    inv_matrices[i].mat[j][l] = 0
    precompute_matrices()
    current_vector = solve_vector(totalCount, current_vector, 0)
    total_sum = 0
    for i in range(baseVal):
        total_sum += current_vector.arr[i]
    total_sum -= 1
    total_sum %= MOD
    if total_sum < 0:
        total_sum += MOD
    while total_sum % (baseVal - 1) != 0:
        total_sum += MOD
    print(total_sum // (baseVal - 1))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
